name: Sensory Ball 0.20mm @Ender3Pro
notes:
Sensory ball process for a stock Ender 3 Pro.
3 walls: the screw threads and the spike tips are made almost entirely of wall, so a third wall makes them solid.
Anti-stringing: the spikes make thousands of travel moves, and every one is a chance to string. Travel 150 mm/s at 1500 mm/s2 (printing stays at 500) and avoid crossing walls OFF keep each travel as short as possible. Tested on a 9-tower grid: clearly cleaner than retraction 3-6 mm or temperature 190-205 C alone.
No supports needed (checked with Orca's strict slicing).
Source: https://github.com/fruch/sensory-ball-print
